description: ignorePaths mirrors the config:recommended defaults but drops **/tests/**.
Custom managers cannot see files under tests/ while that entry is active,
which would silently disable the MongoDbTestImages.cs manager below.
Re-check this list when config:recommended changes its own defaults.

matchStrings: // renovate: datasource=(?<datasource>\S+) depName=(?<depName>\S+) packageName=(?<packageName>\S+)\s+public const String \w+ = "mongo:(?<currentValue>[^"]+)";
